name: Almdorf Ochsengarten
beschreibung: Almdorf Ochsengarten is a chalet village situated at an altitude of approximately 1,500 meters above the Pitztal valley. The individual log chalets, built in traditional alpine timber style, can accommodate up to ten people each and feature private amenities including a sauna, fireplace, and fully equipped kitchen. With its location right on the ski slopes and cross-country ski trails, the village provides direct access to winter sports. During summer, the surrounding forests and alpine pastures serve as an ideal starting point for hiking and mountain biking tours. Almdorf includes private parking and a children's playground. The nearest grocery shopping is located two kilometers away in Ochsengarten, and an on-site dining option is available.
